title: Nexo Knights Nexo Power
description: nexo knights mod that adds structures, weapons armor and bosses from the nexo knights show
body:
this mod adds weapons powers structures and more from the world of Nexo knights.

When you spawn you can craft the weapons fromt he show and the shields
With the shields if you look up you can activate your nexo power
While having nexo power every nexo weapon and armor gets inhanced
With these armor and weapons you can fight the lava monsters(they are replacement for the zombies and iron golems in minecraft)
You can also fight Jestro and Monstrox located in a structure wich is in the nether
In the overworld you may encounter a Rogul statue if you brake it a Rogul will spawn if he hits you will slowly start to become stone slow downa and weaken
When fully stone your demage is increased and you have more resistance 
You can purify yourself with 40 xp levels giving you nexo hand with wich you can shoot a laser and activate nexo power
